name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The trailing tokens are domain IDs, not Ghidra address residue: 0e = dispatch table index 0x0E into the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (xref from table entry 0x51bc9 holds little-endian 0x000345ea); ch5 = chapter 5. 'dialog_with_state' accurately describes the category (writes combat_aux_block AI/dialog state, then shows a dialog). No hex suffix equal to its own or a data address.
purpose: Chapter 5 turn-event slot 0 (turn 3 / phase 0): disarm the per-event AI/dialog control flag for two character ranges, then show dialog page 3.
logic_summary: After the compiler-injected __CHK(0x28) stack probe: calls fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x25,0x28,0) then (0x0D,0x18,0) to zero the low 4 bits of combat_aux_block[0xD] across chars 0x25..0x28 (4 chars) and 0x0D..0x18 (12 chars); then pushes the 8 fixed dialog args (page=3, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) and JMPs to 0x3452F -- handler_09's shared tail (PUSH data_fd2_current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET). Straight-line, no branch, no RNG, no numeric computation; dialog return discarded. Source reproduces the tail JMP as an inline fd2_display_dialog_scene(...) call for Layer-2 equivalence.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl argument passed by the per-event handler dispatch table at 0x51B91; this handler never reads it (turn-event slot, no per-char payload).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the convention used by every sibling handler in chevt1.c, and carries no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; the function falls through into the shared tail which discards fd2_display_dialog_scene's uint32 result and returns.

notes: Verified against disassembly (0x345ea-0x34629 JMP 0x3452f) and the shared tail at 0x3452f (PUSH dword[0x53a79]=data_fd2_current_chapter_text; CALL 0x15f84=fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET). Callee 0x3419c = fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range. Only xref to entry is DATA from dispatch table 0x51bc9 (no direct callers). Source comment (chevt1.c lines 591-622) already precise/accurate/ASCII; Ghidra plate consistent (left untouched). reads_globals reflects the global the function logically reads via the shared tail; combat_aux_block writes go through the callee, not directly. The decompiler prints _data_fd2_current_chapter_text with a leading underscore (overlap warning) but the canonical live data symbol is data_fd2_current_chapter_text, which the source uses correctly.
